output.scope_note: The paper reports the in-plane total ionic (oxygen-ion) conductivity of an inkjet-printed Gd0.2Ce0.8O1.9/Y0.16Zr0.84O1.92 nanocomposite thin film, a solid oxide ion conductor.

records.synthesis_method: hybrid chemical route (colloidal GDC nanoparticles dispersed in metalorganic YSZ sol-gel), inkjet printing
records.evidence_quote: high oxygen ionic conductivity at low temperatures (> 510-3 Scm-1 at
records.notes: Abstract gives a lower bound ('>') for the conductivity; the superscript exponent is lost in PDF extraction, so the value reads as 5x10-3 S/cm but is copied as '510-3'. The 500 °C value is from the abstract; the 0.55 eV activation energy is for the thin film per Section 3.2 (in-plane conductivity of the film, not a bulk value). Measurement range 400–750 °C in synthetic air. The 94.4% density is from the thin-film SEM estimate in Section 3.2 and the 750 °C/6 h is the film calcination.
